sources.title: GitHub - theraker526/Arena-AI-Model-Unlocker-Extension: Unlock hidden ...
sources.snippet: The Arena AI website uses a feature to hide Claude Opus models from the model selector. This extension stops that feature before the page loads and brings back every Opus model. It also unlocks over 150 hidden battle and test models.
